mapper.insert: insert into crm_customer_recharge (recharge_no, customer_id, amount, pay_type, payer_name, payer_account, pay_time, bank_serial_no, voucher_url, status, remark, creator, create_time) values (#{rechargeNo}, #{customerId}, #{amount}, #{payType}, #{payerName}, #{payerAccount}, #{payTime}, #{bankSerialNo}, #{voucherUrl}, 0, #{remark}, #{creator}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select id, recharge_no, customer_id, amount, pay_type, payer_name, payer_account, pay_time, bank_serial_no, voucher_url, status, auditor, audit_time, audit_remark, remark, creator, create_time from crm_customer_recharge where id = #{id}

select id, recharge_no, customer_id, amount, pay_type, payer_name, payer_account, pay_time, bank_serial_no, voucher_url, status, auditor, audit_time, audit_remark, remark, creator, create_time from crm_customer_recharge where id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update crm_customer_recharge set status = #{status}, auditor = #{auditor}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select:
select count(1) from crm_customer_recharge r join crm_customer c on c.id = r.customer_id where r.status = 0
and c.owner_user = #{ownerUser}
